template.name: MM Fibonacci
template.entry_long: close > donchian_high_prev(high,{p0}) and close > donchian_low(low,{p1}) + {p0} * (donchian_high(high,{p2}) - donchian_low(low,10))
template.notes: The 100% Murrey level becomes the 10-bar Donchian high (length not documented) and the most-recent-extreme-is-a-high condition is checked by requiring the break close above the 50% midpoint; the documented exit is the mirror 50% break. The internal Murrey grid below the 50% level is not expressible and docs state no stops.
